Camera arcs a little toward the scholar, both faces stay readable. Zhuge Liang extends his fan slightly toward his opponent below chest level, then returns it. No physical contact.

Main singer's face stays in a frontal or three-quarter view with unobstructed lips. Each microphone stays in the RIGHT hand just below the mouth, not across the lips. Zhuge Liang's LEFT hand holds the white feather fan low. Natural rapid rap articulation and confident body rhythm. Expressive but controlled arm gestures. Audience remains outside the battle circle. Keep both men distinct. No extra fingers, no changing props, no internal cuts, no written words or watermarks.
